purpose: Teach: 消す/素早く/ニコニコ/いやあ/真っ黒/鞄/懐かしく/セーター

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お部屋の電気、本気で、絶対、消す、絶対、のを、絶対、忘れないでね
lines.en: Sho, sweetheart — make absolutely sure you don't forget to turn off the lights in your room, okay?
lines.style: Warm, gently insistent. A mother's familiar refrain delivered without edge. Slight emphasis on the repeated 'absolutely' — patient but clear. Soft eye contact.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、素早く、絶対、お着替え、絶対、できたよ
lines.en: Mom, I really did get dressed super quickly today!
lines.style: Bright with genuine pride. Quick pace, eager to share. Slight lift at the end — seeking her approval and delighted to have it. Unguarded childhood enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さん、本気で、絶対、ニコニコ、絶対、してたわよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was really smiling the whole time, you know.
lines.style: Warm observation, almost to herself at first. Tender recollection. Slow, thoughtful pace. The kind of thing a mother says when she's noticed something her son might not have, and wants him to know it too.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: いやあ、ママ、本気で、絶対、今日は、絶対、楽しかったよ
lines.en: Man, Mom — today was really fun!
lines.style: Bright, unrestrained joy. Quick, animated delivery. The vowels open and alive. Genuine excitement without performance — a child fully present in the moment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お靴の裏、本気で、絶対、真っ黒、絶対、よ、お洗いしましょう
lines.en: Sho, the soles of your shoes are absolutely filthy — let's get them cleaned up.
lines.style: Practical shift. Matter-of-fact but not harsh. Noticing what needs doing and moving to do it. Slight warmth underneath the efficiency — this is care in action.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼくの、本気で、絶対、鞄、絶対、新しいの、絶対、欲しい
lines.en: Mom, I really want a new backpack.
lines.style: Direct, sincere request. Quieter than before — testing the waters. Not demanding, but earnest. The small hesitation of a child who hopes but isn't sure.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママ、本気で、絶対、おばあちゃんの、絶対、お写真、絶対、懐かしく、絶対、見てたの
lines.en: Sho, I was looking at your grandmother's photo earlier and it made me a little nostalgic.
lines.style: Reflective, distant for a moment. Slower cadence. Voice softens with memory. She's speaking half to him, half to herself — a glimpse of something deeper beneath the day's tasks.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼくの、本気で、絶対、セーター、絶対、暖かいよ
lines.en: Mom, my sweater is really warm.
lines.style: Contented observation. Softer than before, almost drowsy. A child noticing comfort in small things. Trailing off gently — the comfortable silence of someone who feels safe.
